title: A worker's brief says every choice its report names is a gate on its branch before it returns
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the ST-dsre52lb worker named two open choices in its report (a minimum word length, a doc wording) and recorded no gate, so the orchestrator sent it back to record two provisional gates before landing. The brief and kb-worker.md say a choice named in the report and not recorded as a gate on work/<id> sends the item back, so the worker records it before returning.
